milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted jungle sapling is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 6). The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=5 ensures they are close enough to visually identify it, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', max_count=132) because green stained glass does NOT drop as an item without Silk Touch enchantment, so inventory_has would always fail. The greenhouse contains exactly 133 green stained glass blocks initially. Setting max_count=132 means at least one block must have been broken/removed from the structure. The box (x=-4 to 4, y=1 to 4, z=8 to 14) encompasses the entire greenhouse walls and ceiling where all glass is located.
